verdict: Robinhood's revenue more than doubled to $1.01B as crypto revenue jumped over 700% to $358M — and profit hit a record $916M, though $369M of it was a one-time tax benefit rather than money from the business.

segments.name: Transaction-based revenues
segments.note: Fees from customers' trades — crypto $358M, options $222M and equities $61M.

segments.name: Net interest revenues
segments.note: Interest on customers' cash and margin loans, plus securities lending — up on growth in interest-earning assets, partly offset by a lower federal funds rate.

segments.name: Other revenues
segments.note: Mostly Robinhood Gold subscriptions — 2.6M subscribers, up 86%.

opex.name: Operations
opex.note: Customer support and running the service — up 12%.

opex.name: Provision for credit losses
opex.note: Money set aside for customer loans that may not be repaid — up 36%.

opex.name: Marketing
opex.note: Advertising and promotions to win new customers — up 91%.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Legal, finance and head office — down 47%, because the line includes a $55M benefit from reversing a regulatory settlement accrual.

otherDetail: Other income, net was $2M — small next to the main business. The tax line is a $358M benefit, driven by a $369M deferred tax benefit from releasing the valuation allowance on most of Robinhood's deferred tax assets.
footerNote: Robinhood does not report a separate cost of revenue; 'Brokerage and transaction' — the direct cost of executing customers' trades — is shown as the direct cost here.
follow100Note: Crypto alone supplied $35.31 of every $100 of revenue — $358M of the $1,014M total — as digital-asset trading rose over 700% from a year ago. The tax benefit added back another $35.31 of every $100.

takeaways.title: Crypto revenue exploded
takeaways.text: Transaction revenue rose 236% to $672M — crypto revenue jumped over 700% to $358M, options rose 83% to $222M and equities rose 144% to $61M as customers traded actively across asset classes.

takeaways.title: Record net deposits
takeaways.text: Net deposits hit $16.1B in the quarter — an annualized growth rate of 42% — and assets under custody rose 88% to $193B, helped by higher equity and cryptocurrency valuations.

takeaways.title: Gold subscribers hit a record
takeaways.text: Robinhood Gold subscribers rose 86% to a record 2.6M, lifting other revenues 31% to $46M — steady subscription income growing alongside the trading business.

oneTimers: A $369M deferred tax benefit ($0.41 of diluted EPS) from releasing the valuation allowance on most of Robinhood's deferred tax assets — management concluded the company is now likely to earn enough to use them. It is a one-time accounting benefit, not cash from the business, and it is most of why the tax line shows a $358M benefit.

A $55M benefit ($0.06 of diluted EPS) from reversing an accrual as part of a regulatory settlement. It sits inside general & administrative expenses, which is why that line fell 47% from a year ago even as the company grew.
